source.note: This snapshot reflects the B2 analytical correction. The older NBA-Visual-Storytelling snapshot remains historical evidence for the Spanish release.

scope.note: Season ranges use season_id; some 2022-season games have calendar dates in 2023.

efficiency.win_rate_denominator: unweighted mean of 1,557 eligible team-season rates
efficiency.ppg_denominator: mean of eligible team-season home or away PPG values

profile.note: Historical player profiles; reported height and weight are unweighted means of team-level averages.

recent_window.win_rate_definition: SUM(wins) / SUM(games_played), matching historical team ranking
